thesis: The v2 workspace is a single dark-signature field console where five modules (Commons, Network, Workbench, Records, Intelligence) share one domain graph and shell chrome. The shell contains exactly one navigation rail, one contextual sidebar, one content canvas, one inspector, and one dock — each with a single job. Hero surfaces are grounded in verified data structures: a three-lens ledger over RollEntry+hash anchors, a force-directed graph explorer over PEOPLE_NETWORK+34 typed relationships, a block-flow simulation builder extending the 6-stage pipeline, a spatial radar panel over field signals, and a declared Intelligence placeholder awaiting a user job. Interaction principles extracted from three reference instruments map to concrete APT-LABS interactions: multi-lane timeline with fork glyph becomes the Records ledger's canonical/proposed/evidence lanes; time scrubber over knowledge graph becomes Network's "evidence as of" filter; drag-predefined-blocks canvas becomes Workbench's stage-gated pipeline builder. Build order S0–S8 is one small reviewable change per step, each gated by npm run build. No Main/Branch, no sixth module, no Intelligence UI before its job exists, no demo theater.

decisions.decision: Five module routes under /workspace: /commons, /network, /workbench, /records, /intelligence — replace current Radar/Undertakings/Roll/Annals/APT Coin Lab labels
decisions.rationale: Charter mandates exactly five modules; current labels (Radar, Undertakings, Roll, Annals, APT Coin Lab, School Console) must reconcile into or under the five. School Console becomes a contextual mode under Records/Workbench, not a primary module.
decisions.risk: Breaks existing bookmarks; needs redirect layer in App.tsx

decisions.decision: Single 5-pane shell: rail (5 module icons), sidebar (contextual tree per module), canvas (hero surface), inspector (record/entity detail), dock (change-set/evidence/history). No environment switcher, no duplicate navigation in dock tabs.
decisions.rationale: Charter: shell chrome must contain no competing navigation systems. V1 studies had Main/Branch switcher (retired), dock tabs duplicating rail, inspector shown only for some modules. New shell unifies.
decisions.risk: WorkspaceShell.tsx (~280 lines) and StudioNavigation.tsx need rewrite; must preserve sidebar/dock collapse localStorage

decisions.decision: Adopt dark signature palette as default: --bg-term #0d110e, --ink #edf4ec, --moss #aab8a7, --teal #87c8c0 (canonical/verified), --lime #c8f292 (proposed/draft), --coral #ea9d7b (risk/exception), --amber #d0b87d (caution/evidence gap). Three type tiers: Georgia serif (record/page names), Inter sans (interface), JetBrains Mono (IDs/timestamps/state labels). Light variant via [data-theme=light] overlay, not separate system.
decisions.rationale: Charter §8: dark is signature system, light is skin variant. Repo-facts: current styles.css is light-first field atlas with no [data-env] blocks. Must invert without new dependencies.
decisions.risk: Auth pages in styles.css share tokens; changes must not break sign-in/up

decisions.decision: Three-lens ledger view over RollEntry + hash_anchor + RollRevision: (1) Canon lane — accepted events with teal markers, (2) Proposed lane — draft changes with lime markers + fork glyph at divergence, (3) Roll lane — evidence layers (public/participant/restricted) with amber gaps. Time-axis scrubs all three lanes together.
decisions.rationale: Repo-facts: src/lib/db/roll.ts has RollEntry (participants, capability_claims, evidence_ids, evidence_layers, hash_anchor, acceptance_block) and RollRevision (previous/new hash). Charter §5: Canon/Annals/Roll must be conceptually distinct but navigable together.
decisions.risk: Current /workspace/roll and /workspace/annals are separate pages; must merge into single Records module with three lenses

decisions.decision: Force-directed graph explorer promoted from existing NetworkMap (src/components/NetworkMap.tsx) over PEOPLE_NETWORK 31 entities + 34 typed relationships. Entity-type colors: Person=teal, Crew=lime, Asset=amber, Institution=coral, Work=mono, Evidence=dim. 'Evidence as of' time scrubber filters relationship visibility by recordBasis timestamp. Search + entity legend pinned.
decisions.rationale: Repo-facts: src/lib/people-network.ts has 34 typed relationships (17 kinds incl evidence links) with recordBasis. NetworkMap exists but is People-specific. Charter §4: Network = understand and connect people, crews, institutions, assets, capabilities, relationships.
decisions.risk: Current /workspace/institutions/network is CapabilityDirectory; must promote NetworkMap to module-level explorer

decisions.decision: Block-flow simulation builder extending src/lib/workbench-simulation.ts 6-stage pipeline (tender-review → assembly → delivery → acceptance → deployment → pause/resume/cancel). Canvas: predefined blocks (WorkOpportunity, CapabilityMatch, AuthorizationGate, EvidenceGate, Settlement) dragged into lanes; stage gates require evidence attachment before transition. Version badge shows simulation hash anchor from RollPreview.
decisions.rationale: Repo-facts: workbench-simulation.ts has 6 stages, RollPreview with hash_anchor, unresolvedFacts[]. Local-workflows.ts has application state machine. Charter: Workbench = scope, assemble, coordinate, manage productive work. Reference instrument: drag-predefined-blocks canvas with zoom + version badge.
decisions.risk: Current /workspace/workbench/simulate is FieldDesk; must generalize to block-flow builder without inventing fake blocks

decisions.decision: RadarSpatialPanel (existing) over EXAMPLE_FIELD_SIGNALS promoted to module canvas. Three panels: (1) Signal map — geospatial field observations, (2) Triage queue — steward decisions with coral/amber/lime state chips, (3) Governance log — accepted proposals linking to Workbench work definitions. No duplicate radar in dock.
decisions.rationale: Repo-facts: src/lib/ecosystem-examples.ts has EXAMPLE_FIELD_SIGNALS. Radar exists at /workspace/commons. Charter: Commons = discover and express needs, offers, resources, opportunities, knowledge, problems.
decisions.risk: Must not become a social feed; every signal must have explicit source basis and triage state

decisions.decision: Declared placeholder — no UI built. User job that must exist first: 'An institution needs to allocate a budget across crews with verified capability matches, and wants a ranked shortlist with evidence trails and conflict-of-interest flags.' Conceptually today (no UI): matching (capability → work), forecasting (pipeline → capacity), graph analysis (network → structural gaps).
decisions.rationale: Charter §4: Intelligence = use agents, graph analysis, matching, forecasting, analytics to interpret and improve the system. Charter §7: every feature must answer 'what decision or action does this improve, and who holds authority?' No credible answer yet → no UI.
decisions.risk: Stakeholders may pressure for AI dashboard; must hold line per charter

decisions.decision: Single hierarchy: eyebrow (module/context) → h1 (record/page name, serif) → subtitle (one sentence, operational) → primary action (if any). Metrics only where they drive the current decision (e.g., Records shows head hash + entity count; Workbench shows stage gate status). No four-metric ritual on every page.
decisions.rationale: User ruling #3: 'Do not force every page into an identical four-metric header.' V1 Main study had 4 metrics on every page; Branch study had none. Hierarchy must serve the decision.
decisions.risk: Existing pages have varied head patterns; must audit and unify
